name: Pedal Moped, up to 1.5 kW and 50 km/h
description: The pedalled moped the classifications naming this group share: an e-bike past its jurisdiction's e-bike limits, with pedals and a motor of no more than 1,500 W that can't propel it faster than 50 km/h. A vehicle carries this group's id in place of each classification in it, and each of those holds its own jurisdiction's licence, registration, insurance, helmet and riding rules.

restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 1(1); Highway Traffic Act, R.S.N.L. 1990, c. H-3, s. 2(mm)

restrictions.rule: Its motor produces no more than 1,500 W
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.N.L. 1990, c. H-3, s. 2(mm); Motor Vehicle Act Regulations, B.C. Reg. 26/58, s. 1

restrictions.rule: The motor can't propel it faster than 50 km/h
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 1(1); The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 1(1); Highway Traffic Act, R.S.N.L. 1990, c. H-3, s. 2(mm)

restrictions.rule: Past its jurisdiction's e-bike limits; one within them is a power-assisted bicycle instead
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 1(1); The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 1(1)
